pages.title: Ancient Skills
pages.text: Prehistoric creatures have controllable powers for travel and work.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Tame Subterranodon with Trilocaris Tails and land often because a rider limits climbing. Stun Tremorsaurus with a club then immediately feed salad. Atlatitan follows volcano-boss access; salad grants temporary riding.

pages.title: Field notes
pages.text: Ambersol gives daylight-like cave illumination without making fauna safe. Trilocaris tails support the flying companion and ancient plants provide separate care inputs.
